headline: The next good idea
copy:
The next good idea may be a conversation away. Tell us what your business is trying to make possible. We will help shape the next step.

https://caprastudios.co/
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Direct is a design decision
copy:
Working with a small team means talking directly to the people shaping the work. Questions reach the people who can answer them.

https://caprastudios.co/
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: A point of view
copy:
A studio identity should feel like the work it makes. Ours has room for clear type, bold color, useful software and a little after-dark experimentation.

https://caprastudios.co/
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Both sides of the studio
copy:
Try the light switch on our site. The same work takes on a different atmosphere. Which side feels more like your next project?

https://caprastudios.co/
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: One useful starting point
copy:
A new project does not need to begin with a long feature list. Start with one problem you want to solve and the person it needs to help.

https://caprastudios.co/
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Made in Atlanta
copy:
We are a small team of specialists in Atlanta. Bring us a product idea, a website that needs a new chapter or a workflow worth improving.

https://caprastudios.co/
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Name the next action
copy:
A useful screen makes the next action understandable. Before adding another button, ask what decision the person is here to make.

https://caprastudios.co/work.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Design the handoff
copy:
Good software carries context from one person to the next. A handoff should not require someone to reconstruct the whole story.

https://caprastudios.co/work.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Beyond the happy path
copy:
Missing information, errors and recovery are part of the product. We design those moments alongside the ideal flow.

https://caprastudios.co/work.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: The spreadsheet question
copy:
If a spreadsheet has become the operating system for a process, it may be time to map what the team actually needs. That map comes before the application.

https://caprastudios.co/work.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Make the status visible
copy:
Waiting, reviewing, approved, complete: a clear state tells a team where the work is and what can happen next.

https://caprastudios.co/work.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Built around people
copy:
Custom software is most useful when it reflects the work of the people using it. Roles, context and real decisions should shape the interface.

https://caprastudios.co/work.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: A reason to move
copy:
Before we animate something, we ask what the movement is doing. Guiding attention? Explaining a change? Giving the brand a moment?

https://caprastudios.co/motion.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: The first impression
copy:
The opening of a website should establish a point of view and make the next step clear. Good-looking and useful belong in the same brief.

https://caprastudios.co/motion.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: A small interaction
copy:
A small response can change how a page feels. Motion can acknowledge an action without taking over the experience.

https://caprastudios.co/motion.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Keep the story clear
copy:
A brand film needs a beginning, a change and a payoff. Even twenty seconds is enough to tell a considered story.

https://caprastudios.co/motion.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: When the motion stops
copy:
A website should still make sense when motion is paused. Clear copy and a considered static composition are part of the design.

https://caprastudios.co/motion.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Depth with purpose
copy:
A 3D piece should give an idea something a flat frame cannot: form, atmosphere, perspective or a transformation worth watching.

https://caprastudios.co/motion.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Define the job
copy:
Before building an agent, finish this sentence: When a person asks for this, the system should do that. A clear job makes a better starting point.

https://caprastudios.co/ai-consulting.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Knowledge has owners
copy:
A knowledge system needs more than documents. It needs current information, access rules and people responsible for keeping it useful.

https://caprastudios.co/ai-consulting.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Retrieval before response
copy:
A RAG system retrieves relevant information and gives it to the model as context. The quality of that retrieval matters to the usefulness of the answer.

https://caprastudios.co/ai-consulting.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: A helpful handoff
copy:
A support agent should know what details to collect and when a person should take over. The handoff is part of the design.

https://caprastudios.co/ai-consulting.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Permission by design
copy:
Connecting an agent to a tool is only one part of the work. Define which actions it may take, which need approval and how exceptions are handled.

https://caprastudios.co/ai-consulting.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: A useful pilot
copy:
A pilot should answer a decision: is this system useful enough to expand? Agree how you will judge that before building it.

https://caprastudios.co/ai-consulting.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Use the tools you have
copy:
An AI project does not automatically mean replacing the tools already in the business. Start by reviewing what can be connected.

https://caprastudios.co/ai-consulting.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Measure the right things
copy:
Useful answers, successful handoffs, errors, time and operating cost can all matter. Choose the measures that fit the workflow.

https://caprastudios.co/ai-consulting.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: A roadmap, not a shopping list
copy:
An operating roadmap connects workflows, people, knowledge and tools. A list of AI products does not do that on its own.

https://caprastudios.co/ai-consulting.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Keep the business in control
copy:
As automation expands, responsibilities should stay clear. Build monitoring, approvals and human review into the operating approach.

https://caprastudios.co/ai-consulting.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Course, pace, fuel
copy:
TrailGoat brings course planning, pace and fueling together for trail and ultra runners. Explore the product and the brand film on our site.

https://caprastudios.co/work.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: A moment in staffing
copy:
Purple Squirrel is designed around a specific handoff: a recruiter submits a candidate and a client reviews them. That focus shapes the experience.

https://caprastudios.co/work.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Twenty seconds of transformation
copy:
Our TrailGoat brand film begins with blocks and resolves into a wordmark. Between those points, the identity gets a little life.

https://caprastudios.co/work.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: A product and its story
copy:
For TrailGoat, design, development and motion sit together. The application does the work; the film gives the identity another way to be seen.

https://caprastudios.co/work.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Bring the rough idea
copy:
Bring the rough idea. Bring the broken process. Bring the website you have outgrown. A useful first conversation can begin with any of them.

https://caprastudios.co/
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Color can do a job
copy:
Color can guide, distinguish and give a brand a voice. On Capra’s site, it changes with the light while the underlying experience stays coherent.

https://caprastudios.co/motion.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Clarity is a feature
copy:
Sometimes the most valuable feature is knowing exactly what is happening and what to do next. That is a worthwhile software brief.

https://caprastudios.co/work.html
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.

headline: Let us make it tangible
copy:
What are you imagining next? Tell Capra about the thing you want to make or improve. We will help find the right way to build it.

https://caprastudios.co/
alt_text: Capra Studios unicorn mark.
